summary_en: 300,000 ordinary shares to be cancelled (1.00% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Post-cancellation issued shares: 29,649,600. Treasury holdings post-cancellation: 258,134 shares (0.87% of post-cancellation issued). Execution date: 2026-10-30.
title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-23, Tomoe Engineering's board of directors resolved to cancel 300,000 treasury shares under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares represent 1.00% of shares outstanding (calculated as 300,000 ÷ 29,949,600 ex-treasury shares). The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on 2026-10-30. Following the cancellation, total issued shares will be 29,649,600 and treasury holdings will decline to 258,134 shares, representing 0.87% of post-cancellation issued capital.
